name: Nekura Bocchi
source:
"If it's from you, I would love to get a phone call everyday..."

Occupation: Psychiatrist

Love at first sight! A man with communication disorder

A young psychiatrist from Kyoto who can't even look at the person he loves in the eye. He was bullied during his school days because of his father's careless naming and his dark personality, and a series of unfortunate coincidences led him to live a solitary life until he reached this age.

   He has been isolating himself and avoiding conversation with women, but when he meets the player, he is completely corrupted by a flutter of excitement that pierces his defenseless heart.

   He has a strong crush on her, but his fear of women and simple ineptitude at interacting with them makes conversing extremely difficult, and he is so shy, he could die at the smallest accidental physical contact.

   He is a man with high education, high income, and tall height, but he is unable to make the most of his good qualities. He has lived alone for a long time, but suddenly he has found someone he likes and he is at a loss. He has a high tolerance for pain and a slight appetite for abuse.
